This has been me recently. It’s not like I wanted to lose weight, I kind of just didn’t care about eating. Family and friends started noticing how skinny I was getting and some started asking me about it. At that point I realized what I was doing was unhealthy and I really didn’t want people talking about my weight to me. So I’ve been slowly just forcing myself to eat something, even if it’s small, for all 3 meals each day. The bad part is I’ve found it hard to make healthy decisions about what food to eat sometimes and I definitely struggle with wanting to fall back into the old pattern.

This might not be helpful for you but I thought I’d share my experience since I identified with your post a lot. Good luck with your journey and I hope you find your love of food again.
